## Explore the College Drinking Dataset

Run the code below to import the dataset and learn about its structure.

```{webr-r}
drinking_data <- read.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhengyangzhou/moodle-webr2/main/data/college_drinking_long.csv"
)

# Look at the first few rows
head(drinking_data)

# Check the size of the dataset
dim(drinking_data)

# Look at variable names
names(drinking_data)

# Examine variable types and structure
str(drinking_data)

# Get a quick summary
summary(drinking_data)

# Examine assessment times
table(drinking_data$month)

# Examine treatment groups
table(drinking_data$treatment)

# Examine studies
table(drinking_data$study_id)

# Examine study-by-treatment combinations
table(drinking_data$study_id,
      drinking_data$treatment)

# Check the mandated variable
table(drinking_data$mandated)

# Check for missing values
colSums(is.na(drinking_data))
```
